title: Surfhouse Residences
location: Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale), near Bang Tao / Laguna
shortDescription: Surfhouse Residences is a boutique seven-storey condominium of 34 residences in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, developed and managed by SALA Hospitality Group.
description: Surfhouse Residences is a boutique seven-storey condominium of 34 residences in Cherngtalay, Thalang, Phuket, developed and managed by SALA Hospitality Group. Units range from one to three bedrooms. Facilities include an 18-metre saltwater pool, gym, lobby lounge and concierge service.
facilities: Rental management and housekeeping by SALA
